integrity: Analytic proofs and reproducible exact-rational symbolic checks; no assertion of independent review, formal certification, or exhaustive historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-step finite Markov generators only; the all-step sufficient graph-depth condition is restricted to acyclic transition graphs. The four-state statement is local in step size. The exact threshold is for a unit-rate five-state pure-birth chain, not arbitrary five-state models. It does not imply positivity of full PDE solvers or nonlinear stages.
title: Three-transition immunity and a sharp five-state positivity threshold for the second-order Padé Markov step
